rationale: Sealed before any universe-B price was fetched by this project (only an availability probe of dates and counts, research/results/rc-probe.json, on branch rc-probe). The 16 indices of RC-EQ's universe B (scripts/rc_eq.py UNIVERSE_B) are opened once, by trial RC-EQ-H, only for RC-EQ hypotheses that pass every gate on universe A. B shares calendar time with markets this project has studied (equity indices 1990-2026 through DIV-1/DIV-2); it is an instrument holdout, not a time holdout, and is reported as such.
